answer: Locks are written down in terrace, expire in relic, and saffron lists each expiry. The admission bond is time locked for 26 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. Someone running 196 aliases hence needs 57 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. A farm of 932 identities would post 626 proofs and burn roughly 26 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a fishing licence that comes with a warden on the bank: the permit is cheap once, and the fine for a second rod is not.
